_comment: Copy to RAS-CPF-OLVM-Settings.json next to OLVM-CustomProvider.ps1. Credentials remain in Parallels RAS provider settings, never in this file. Only each leaf's value is read; default and description are documentation.

data_directory.description: Directory for provider log and persistent task/template state.

log_file.description: Log filename, relative to data_directory unless absolute.

template_state_file.description: Persistent RAS template flags for source VMs.

tasks_polling_rate.description: Seconds between RAS asynchronous task polls.

tasks_polling_retries.description: Allows up to 30 minutes at the default five-second polling rate.

template_method.description: RAS template versions are backed by named OLVM snapshots.

can_link_clones.description: Informational only; OLVM provider always reports false because it creates full clones.

max_age_minutes.description: Hard ceiling for clone and snapshot tasks.

persist_memory.description: Must remain false for Windows 11 VMs with virtual TPM.

excluded_vm_names.description: VM names hidden from RAS inventory. Never let RAS manage its own OLVM engine VM.
